Southwark Cyclists Healthy Rides

London, United Kingdom · Varies (south and east London) · Social

Beginner friendly

Southwark Cyclists Healthy Rides is a social group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am local time from Varies — posted on the Healthy Rides page. Pace: short, easy-paced rides on local roads and paths, about 10–18 miles, groups of around 15.

For visitors

Open to anyone, whatever age, wherever they live. Register on Eventbrite for each ride. Under-18s must come with an adult.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: short, easy-paced rides on local roads and paths, about 10–18 miles, groups of around 15.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Southwark Cyclists Healthy Rides group ride

Short guided Saturday rides from Southwark Cyclists, the local London Cycling Campaign group. Routes are themed tours: city alleyways, the Lee Valley, the Frieze sculptures in Regent's Park, the Thames Barrier. Made for less experienced riders who want company and a route.
